# CANDIDATE: FIX_WINNER_DAYS_LOSS

**Filed:** 2026-09-05  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The baseline engine loses on two of three J winner days (4/29 and 5/01) while capturing the 5/04 winner. This suggests the engine's entry logic is too permissive on suboptimal bearish setups, entering trades that fail to ride the ribbon. By tightening a quality filter (e.g., bear_score threshold) we can avoid these losses and convert them to breakeven or small wins, increasing edge_capture above the 771 floor.

## Mechanism

Adjust the `bear_score` entry filter from its baseline value (unknown) to a higher threshold (e.g., 8→9) on days resembling 4/29 and 5/01 structure. This will suppress entries when ribbon confluence or volume confirmation is weak. We will test thresholds via grid search and select the one that maximizes edge_capture while preserving the 5/04 win. Exit logic remains unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock).

2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest ran on full available history (approx 16 months 2025-01 to 2026-06). Selection method: exhaustive grid over empty combo (baseline only). Overfit risk: HIGH -- we are optimizing solely on two anchor days (4/29, 5/01) without OOS validation.
